schedules.name: Souhrn pro majitele (ráno)
schedules.title: Souhrn pro majitele (ráno)
schedules.notes:
Purpose: one bundled Czech message for the owner instead of pings from every agent. Source: the Chief of Staff's routine.

Follow 'The owner digest' in your instructions. Nothing waiting: send nothing, complete with 'nic'.
schedules.definition_of_done: Either one digest message was sent in the owner's DM, or nothing was waiting and the note says so.

schedules.notes:
Purpose: the afternoon bundle for the owner. Source: the Chief of Staff's routine.

Follow 'The owner digest' in your instructions. Nothing new since the morning: send nothing.
schedules.definition_of_done: Either one digest message was sent in the owner's DM, or nothing was waiting and the note says so.
